integrity: Proof uses a self-contained complete acyclic-Morse certificate over all 10,896 nonempty simplices; no claim of external certification or independent review.
scientific_limitations: For the 28-vertex Coxeter graph only; nonequivariant integral homotopy and all-field persistence. No larger-family classification, symmetry representation or quotient type. Unindexed equivalent publication risk and independent verification remain.
title: Complete graph-metric Rips homotopy filtration of the Coxeter graph
